title: Imperial Star Destroyer — Devastator Intercept
description: A sweeping armored dagger with a deep equatorial machinery trench, eight twin-barrel batteries, seven horizontal engines, terraced command decks and twin faceted shield generators. A captured miniature blockade runner waits beneath the open ventral hangar. The hollow hull rests on a compact black display cradle.

sections.name: Hollow keel, armor ribs and ventral hangar
Sloped port and starboard armor shells
Terraced command citadel and T-shaped bridge
Three main drives and four auxiliary engines
